title: The Counterweight Lift
speaker: kenji
intro: The lift is a giant see-saw, Max-kun. The load is 60 blocks sitting 2 arms out — so our side must MULTIPLY to the same: weight × distance = 120. Balance it!
success: Equilibrium! Sixty times two on their side, your clever pick on ours. The lift rises like a polite whale.
goalText: Balance the beam: your weight × your arm length must equal 60 × 2 = 120.
failText: Multiply your weight by its distance — does it make exactly 120?
